ProviderKinds.note: All five provider values with their labels and the prop that produced them. GitHub/Google/Apple are inline brand SVGs; sso and password fall back to the DS Shield and Mail glyphs.

SsoBrandsFromLabel.note: The label-driven SSO branch: Okta, Auth0, GitLab, Microsoft, Google Workspace each resolve to their brand mark, and an unmatched connection name keeps the generic shield.

InSignInButtons.note: The component in its real host — the leading glyph of five AuthProviderButtons, primary and secondary variants.

SizeOverrides.note: className replaces the default icon-control sizing: icon-paired, icon-control, size-8, size-12 at the same glyph.
